description_sq:
DYQAN PER INVESTIM NE SHITJE TEK PORCELANI!
Dyani ndodhet ne nje nga komplekset me te medha dhe me cilesore ne zonen e Porcelanit.
Kompleksi ndodhet buze rruges kryesore, Xhanfize Keko.
Eshte i sapo perfunduar dhe gati per shfrytezim.
Ka nje hapsire neto 640.96 Metra, ka verande te shfrytezueshme ne gjithe gjatesine e tij dhe dyer aksesi nga rruga kryesore, rruga dytesore dhe hapsira e brendshme e kompleksit.
Dyqani ka fasade ne rrugen kryesore ne gjithe gjatesine e vete dhe eshte i dhene me qira me nje kontrate afatgjate dhe qira te kenaqshme me nje kompanite me prestigjoze ne tregun shqiptar.
Per me shume informacion, apo nje vizite ne prone, mos nguroni te kontaktoni!

description_en: INVESTMENT STORE FOR SALE AT PORCELANI! Dyani is located in one of the largest and highest quality complexes in the Porcelan area. The complex is located on the edge of the main road, Xhanfize Keko. It is just completed and ready for use. It has a net space of 640.96 meters, there are usable verandas along its entire length and access doors from the main road, the secondary road and the inner space of the complex. The shop has facades on the main street along its entire length and is leased with a long-term contract and satisfactory rent with one of the most prestigious companies in the Albanian market. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us! ID: 530281026-1016
